subject: 🏃 Sunday — Rest Day (Wk 1)
html:
Tomorrow: Rest Day — End of Week 1

No run, no gym. The long run was already banked yesterday — your two Victoria crew runs totaled 8.27 mi at 8:08 avg with a strong negative split and a 7:38 close on Run 2. That checks the box for Week 1's 8-mile LR, and then some.

Mobility flush (optional): If you've got 10 minutes, foam roll quads and IT band (1 min each side), 90/90 hip switches (10 reps), and the PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side). Skip it guilt-free if the travel schedule doesn't allow — you earned the day off.

Week 1 scorecard: Every session logged at knee 1/5 — track intervals Tuesday, heavy strength Wednesday, 6-mi steady base Thursday, and 8+ mi across two runs Saturday. The only signal is the 1.5/5 stretching awareness after Run 2. That's inside the green band, but worth noting: if it shows up again post-run on a non-travel day, mention it. For now, no plan changes.

Looking ahead: Week 2 starts Monday with the Hip Complex Circuit. Tuesday is 6×800m at the track (7:15–7:25 pace), and Bay to Breakers is next Sunday — your first fast-finish benchmark. This week jumps from 17 mi to 24 mi, so recovery tonight and tomorrow matters.

Focus cue: Hydrate and eat well today. Travel days are sneaky dehydration traps — aim for 80+ oz of water and a protein-forward dinner tonight. Get to bed at a reasonable hour so Monday's circuit starts fresh.
